Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
What's the timing of choosing whether Ghoul Retainer will
use a weapon or inflict its default 1 damage?

Text: "Each round of combat during strike resolution, the
Ghoul Retainer inflicts 1 damage or may use a weapon that
is not being used by the employing minion (or another
retainer) during that round. This is not a strike, although
it does count as "using" the weapon."

It sounds like the choice is made during strike resolution.
Just at the moment, I'd really like it to be made during
strike declaration, but the only argument off the top of my
head is that "regular" minions (eg vampires) act as if they
had the text "during strike resolution inflicts 1 damage or
may use a weapon", and they have to choose what their strike
will be during strike declaration. :-)

Josh

ensaddened

> > strike declaration, but the only argument off the top of my
> > head is that "regular" minions (eg vampires) act as if they
> > had the text "during strike resolution inflicts 1 damage or
> > may use a weapon", and they have to choose what their strike
> > will be during strike declaration. :-)
>
> Not sure what difference it would make, except for some strange
> "let's play nice" scenarios.

Suppose the minion without Ghoul Retainer wants to strike
with Canine Horde at [ANI]. If the choice for the Ghoul to
use a weapon is made during strike declaration, it can be
"shot out from under it" just like it can be with a vampire
using the weapon (unless the vampire/Ghoul were to have
First Strike as well). But if the choice is made during
strike resolution, the Ghoul will always at least be able
to inflict its base 1 damage.

I doubt that this changes your answer, though. Nor should
it, probably. :-)

Josh

ghouled vagabond mystic

Messages.Author: LSJ

Timlagor wrote:
> If you steal a weapon with First Strike, can your ghoul use that weapon?
